Data.name: framework nLab
Data.release_name: Static-First Data Bridge & Metadata V2 Cleanup
single_source_rules: Canonical framework paths exist only in this manifest.
Allowed metadata.json_type values belong only to json-types.json.
Allowed metadata.scope values belong only to metadata.schema.json.
Action semantics belong only to button-registry.json.
Icon identity belongs only to icon-registry.json.
Button visual templates belong only to button-templates.json.
Visual token semantics belong only to design-tokens.json.
Theme availability and default theme belong only to theme-registry.json.
Data backend semantics belong only to data-access-contract.json.
Automatic/manual value-resolution semantics belong only to value-resolution.json and its schema.
Public editorial field structure belongs only to editorial.schema.json; actual editorial content belongs to project/source data or help-registry as appropriate.
Public contextual-help wording belongs only to help-registry.json.
Provider-specific mappings live only in provider adapters.
Schemas define field contracts and generate data dictionaries.
Dev help derives technical facts from canonical metadata, schemas, registries, data-access and composition instead of copying them.
Primitive UI mechanics are composed instead of duplicated.

versioning.release_manifests: historical snapshots archived outside active framework; never canonical

governance.schema_validation: required for every active framework JSON artifact
governance.documentation_generation: public help registry + metadata + schema + registry + generated dev overlay

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Source canonique de version, gouvernance et chemins; aucune tolérance Metadata V1 active.
